identification: Group of 5 Australian Shell tins, 1960s-70s: one Shell Spirax 90 EP quart cone-top oil tin, two Retinax A grease tins (about 1 lb to 2 lb), a plain Shell grease tin and a Shell Grease 450g tube tin. General wear, some rust, lids on some. Common later-era Shell packaging, not the early gallon tins that make real money.
